title: Model Directory
description: Override the models base directory. Leave empty to use the default data folder (<data>/ginfer/models).

title: ginfer-serve Binary
description: Path to the ginfer-serve executable. Leave empty to use the default location (<data>/ginfer/bin/ginfer-serve).

title: Vision
description: Enable image and video inputs. Enabled by default for GInfer's multimodal model packages. Startup-only.

title: Speculative Decoding
description: Auto selects the model package's DFlash2 sidecar when present; Off uses autoregressive decoding. Startup-only.

title: Draft Tokens
description: DFlash2 draft window (1-7). Auto uses the model package default, currently 4 for compatible packages.

title: DFlash2 Tensor Parallelism
description: Auto uses the package/runtime placement. An explicit value can run the DFlash2 body on fewer ranks than the target model. Startup-only.

title: KV Cache Dtype
description: Auto uses GInfer's server default. Explicit storage choices are BF16, INT8, and NVFP4. Startup-only.

title: KV Arena Size
description: Auto lets GInfer size each rank's physical KV arena from available memory. An explicit value is an exact byte count. Startup-only.

controllerProps.placeholder: Auto or an exact byte count

title: Prefill Chunk
description: Prefill chunk size. Auto uses the GInfer server default (1024); explicit values must be positive multiples of 128.

title: Max Concurrency
description: Maximum active generations (1-8). Auto uses the GInfer server default (1).

title: Auto Unload
description: Unload any other loaded GInfer model before loading a new one.
